# CustomDance integration

CustomDance is an upstream MIT-licensed project:

https://github.com/XulongT/CustomDance

This repository pins the upstream source to:

`bfd692329795b2547d477330d29af767cd2c7a5a`

Run:

```bash
bash scripts/bootstrap_customdance.sh
```

This clones that exact revision into `vendor/CustomDance`.

CustomDance's model resources, FineDance dataset and SMPL model are separate downloads governed by their respective terms. Follow the upstream README for those assets.
